I conduct my dissertation research in close collaboration with the Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute and with the Smithsonian Migratory Bird Center. Specifically, [**Dr. Ruth Bennett**](https://profiles.si.edu/display/nBennettR8242018) and the [Smithsonian Bird Friendly Project](https://nationalzoo.si.edu/migratory-birds/bird-friendly) have supported me enormously. 

## 2025 Field Season | Gualaca, Chiriquí, Panamá

In 2025, I worked at the Smithsonian's Fortuna Field Station. My team included **Stefany Flores** and **Josué Justo** with volunteer appearances from (**Nathanya Goudreau**)(https://qcbs.ca/fr/membre-etudiant/?student=3598) and [**Dr. Maureen McClung**](https://www.hendrix.edu/biology/profile.aspx?id=70770). Finally, we worked alongside the Fortuna Field Station's permanent staff including station manager **Carlos Espinosa** and botanist **Bady Garcia** (whose tree diversity work you can see featured on France24 News [here!](https://www.france24.com/es/programas/medio-ambiente/20230630-panama-bosque-fortuna-diversidad-arboles-estados-unidos)).
